entry.label: Variety attenuation
entry.description: Attenuation protects a regulator from being overwhelmed. It can simplify, buffer, aggregate or redesign demand. It can also erase inconvenient people and conditions if the boundary and purpose are wrong.
entry.canonical_definition: A deliberate reduction in effective variety so that relevant disturbances, signals or choices become tractable without pretending the discarded variety never existed.

profile.why_it_matters: Forms, triage, standards, thresholds and dashboards are attenuation devices. Their value depends on whether they preserve the differences needed for responsible action.
